answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 44801 Country: India Title: Islamic Names Question: I have one daughter of 1 year. We kept her name Muslima because one of my Sheikh has suggested me that. Now I want to know the meaning of her name 'Muslima'. Can you please help me for this? Answer ID: 44801 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 603/603/M=1434) Muslima is a good name. It means: a woman who bows her head, obedient and dutiful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
